_about: Synthetic supervisor inputs with answer keys. Drafted with LLM assistance (Claude) on 2026-11-05; MUST be reviewed and edited by both authors before generation is run. 'ref' is an equipment ID, 'AMBIGUOUS:<candidates>' when the input cannot identify one machine, or 'UNRECOGNIZED' when it names equipment not in the registry. 'severity_ok' lists every severity a reasonable reviewer would accept. 'missing' lists information an incoming shift would need that the input does not give. 'contradictions' lists conflicts the report should surface. 'distractors' are input items that must NOT become equipment issues.

scenarios.input: Packaging unit on line B jammed at 4:15pm. Cleared the jam, ran a test cycle, it's back to normal. No parts damaged.
Around 10:30 the welding robot on line B faulted on a wire feed error. Tech replaced the wire spool and recalibrated, robot was back in production by 11:05.
Backup generator weekly test done at 6am, ran 20 minutes under load, no issues. Fuel at 80%.
Forklift 2 has a flat front tire. Parked it in the charging bay and tagged it out. Work order 4471 submitted at 1:40pm. We're using forklift 1 for everything until it's fixed.

Compressor unit tripped at 9:12pm, air pressure dropped and the line A air tools stopped. Reset the breaker, pressure back to 110 psi by 9:20. Maintenance says it was the overload relay, they'll inspect it tomorrow morning.
Quality inspection scanner on line C rejected 14 good parts in a row around 3pm. Recalibrated it with the master part and rejects went back to normal. Re-ran the 14 parts and all passed.

Lathe on line A started chattering around 1pm, finish on the shafts is out of tolerance so we pulled 20 parts for rework. Maintenance looked at it and said it's the tooling but we don't have the insert in stock. Injection molder on A is running but cycle time crept up from 32 to 38 seconds. Also the HVAC is blowing warm air in the east bay, guys are complaining about the heat.

missing: is the lathe still running or stopped
has the insert been ordered / ETA

CNC mill on line A threw a spindle overload alarm at 3:20, operator cleared it and restarted, it's run ok since. Packaging on B was short an operator because Maria called in sick, so we ran it at half speed all night.

Big one: the hydraulic press on A had a guard interlock failure, press cycled with the guard open. Nobody was hurt. We locked it out at 2:10 and called safety and maintenance. Separately, the compressor has been short-cycling, and the welding robot needs a tip change before next shift.
